latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release.

- 4 fetcher modes: http, async, stealth (Camoufox), dynamic (Playwright)
- CSS selector-based content extraction with auto_save / auto_match
- Proxy support with humanize, geoip, block-webrtc options
- --disable-resources and --block-images for faster scraping
- --retry N with exponential backoff
- Structured JSON output with per-page title, markdown, and status
